missing_points: Sensor performance degraded (range reduction from 50mm spec to intermittent detection), narrowed to contamination in the connector affecting signal integrity
Root cause: moisture or coolant ingress into the connector causing intermittent electrical contact or signal noise
Long-term fix: use sealed M12 connectors, cable management to route away from coolant spray, or relocate sensor to protected area
correctness.note: Gives generic proximity-sensor troubleshooting, but does not identify the connector/moisture/coolant ingress failure mode or the permanent environmental fix.

grounding.note: No citations were provided, so grounding cannot be assessed against source documents.

diagnostic.note: Starts with broad checks (alignment/cleaning) rather than the highest-value discriminating check: connector/cable contamination and intermittent signal integrity.

actionability.note: Provides concrete steps and what to inspect, but lacks the expected specific test/observation sequence and the environmental corrective action.

uncertainty.note: Reasonably cautious and non-committal, but the diagnosis remains too generic for the case details.

context.note: Stays on the sensor issue, but does not narrow to the supplied failure mode or the permanent fix.
